newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen extending slight downtrend.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen extending slight downtrend.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to continue their slight downtrend on Monday as the run-up to September's elections and macroeconomic concerns such as higher money supply and possible higher market rates dampened buying.

Analysts were divided on the effect on the main market of last week's news the Securities Commission had notified the public prosecutor that a group of investors may have illegally manipulated prices.

Largely prices of parallel market firms are suspected, such as Chemiskor, which will trade on Monday without the 10-percent price fluctuation limit after it did not trade after fixing for three sessions running due to excess supply.
